encoding.mv_k{k}_{G|T}.u16: uint16 per board of the k-goat movement layer (15 - k captured), index rank3(tigers)*C(20,k) + rank_k(goats); 0 draw, 2d mover wins in d plies, 2d+1 mover loses in d plies
encoding.pl_n{n}_{G|T}.u2: 2 bits per position of placement layer n (n goats placed), blocks c = 0..min(n,5) at block_offsets, each indexed like a movement layer with k = n - c; 0 draw, 1 mover wins, 2 mover loses; position i in bits 2*(i%4) of byte i//4 (deleted after matching the .u8 tables; solve.py rewrites them)
encoding.pl_n{n}_{G|T}.u8: uint8 per position of placement layer n (n goats placed), blocks c = 0..min(n,5) at placement.{n}.block_offsets, each indexed like a movement layer with k = n - c; 0 draw, d + 1 otherwise, d = plies to the end (odd: mover wins, even: mover loses)

placement_dtm.encoding: uint8 per position of placement layer n (n goats placed), blocks c = 0..min(n,5) at placement.{n}.block_offsets, each indexed like a movement layer with k = n - c; 0 draw, d + 1 otherwise, d = plies to the end (odd: mover wins, even: mover loses)
